STRETCHY PLASTIC BAGS/FILM CAN NOW BE RECYCLED AT THE DODGE COUNTY RENOVATION REUSE BUILDING LOCATED AT 406 16TH ST NW KASSON. PLEASE SEE INSTRUCTIONS FOR WHAT IS ACCEPTABLE AND NOT ACCEPTABLE. THE PLASTIC MUST BE CLEAN, DRY AND EMPTY OF ITEMS/RECEIPTS. IF UNACCEPTABLE MATERIAL IS DROPPED OFF - IT WILL GET REFUSED. THANK YOU! PLASTIC BAG/FILM RECYCLING RULES GREAT NEWS: #5 CLEAR Clamshell containers are now acceptable in the blue bins and your recycling carts!! If they are not #5 OR IF THEY ARE STYROFOAM OR BLACK PLASTIC they will still go in your garbage container. Thank you! The Recycling Blue Bins have been returned. However, the bins behind the Recycling Center building will still be removed from Saturday at Noon until Monday morning until further notice. Please remember to flatten your boxes and put all the packaging from in the boxes in your garbage. Illegal dumping is a misdemeanor and punishable by citation and a fine. Please dispose of items properly and if you have any questions, please call us at 507-635-6273. We do not want to have to remove them permanently so please help us keep the recycling free of contamination. Ask the Waste Wizard above where things go if you don't know. Thank you! THANK YOU! Thank you to all who contacted your legislators in support of the new Transfer Station building at the Dodge County Transfer Station. Dodge County received funding in the bonding bill that passed in May of 2023. We appreciate your support. We are looking forward to the new building being constructed to help us serve Dodge County's waste needs! Below are some pictures of the new Building 4 at the Transfer Station! The building is complete and in full use! How to Powerpoint Video for the Dodge County Transfer Station UPDATES: (Sign up here for E-Notify) Please see the Waste-To-Energy Fact Sheet to learn about the 4% increase to the Waste-To-Energy Service fee effective for your January hauler bill in 2023. 2026 Transfer Station Fees (All prices subject to change.) Due to changes in our process and handling of mattresses and box springs, the Board of County Commissioners approved an increase in price of these materials to $30 each to cover the cost of recycling and transportation effective March 24th, 2021. Do not put mattresses or box springs by your curbside collection bin. 2026-2027 HOLIDAY SCHEDULE - Dodge County Transfer Station DESIGNATION - Dodge County has a designation ordinance which means that all garbage(MSW- municipal solid waste) generated in Dodge County must come to the Dodge County Facility. See below - Solid Waste Ordinance #2. Olmsted County also has a designation ordinance where Olmsted County residents must take their garbage(MSW) to an Olmsted County Facility. Recycling and demolition debris are not designated. If you are from Olmsted County and bring trash/garbage to the Dodge County Transfer Station please be prepared to pay an additional $20 out of county fee. Thanks. SELF-SERVE WASTE DEPOT Below is the agreement and rules - if further questions please call 507-635-6273. *If you are already a Self-Serve Customer - ask us how you can re-order bags by mail. This service is for Dodge County residents only. Self-Serve Waste Depot Agreement Rules of Use CURBSIDE GARBAGE COLLECTION is provided by licensed haulers. All haulers are required to provide their customers with volume based pricing..."so the less you throw away, the less you pay". Some of the licensed haulers do not do curbside residential service so please call and check which company fits your needs. DODGE COUNTY LICENSED HAULERS LRS of Rochester | 507-281-5850 | | Veit Disposal | 507-281-3867 | | Waste Management of Rochester | 507-282-2420 | | Freeborn County Coop Oil | 507-373-3991 | | Skjeveland Enterprises | 507-528-9900 | | Aspen Waste Systems | 507-268-5349 | | Harter's Disposal of MN | 507-910-8053 | | Thompson Sanitation Inc | 507-256-4370 | | Tracy Services | 507-291-0299 | | Rural Garbage Collection can be provided by licensed haulers, but it may be hard to find a hauler to service remote areas. If hauling service is not available, garbage is accepted at the Dodge County Transfer Station. Fees are based on weight and volume of waste. Or check out the Self-Serve Waste Depot (above) for another option. Junk/Self-Haulers Registered in Dodge County Junk It - Call Brady at 507-254-7833 or email Junk_it_removal@yahoo.com | OCHOA Junk Removal & Hauling Services - please call Juan at 507-538-9370 or email ochoasjunkremoval@gmail.com | DODGE COUNTY TRANSFER STATION accepts waste from haulers, businesses, and residents. Waste is processed and transported to the Olmsted Waste-to-Energy Facility where it is converted into steam and electricity. LOCATION: 62236 240th Ave Kasson, MN *1 mile N of Kasson on Cty Rd 21 Map to Transfer Station HOURS: Monday 8 a.m. - 6 p.m. Tuesday-Friday 8 a.m. - 3 p.m. Saturday 8 a.m. - Noon PHONE: 507-634-7875 The station also accepts: construction & demolition debris, brush & leaves, clean wood, fluorescent lamps, appliances, used oil & filters, tires, mattresses, box springs, antifreeze and electronic waste. PAINT The Recycling Center (Building #3) can now accept PaintCare acceptable material such as oil based and latex architectural paint during business hours only. Please visit www.paintcare.org to find acceptable items. STAFF Zach Schultz - Transfer Station Site Manager Mark Brannan David Fitzgerald Mike Skjeie PUNCH CARDS are available for customers who self-haul their trash to the Transfer Station in bags. The cost to dispose of a bag of trash is $5.00/bag but with the punch card you can dispose of 10 bags for $45. A savings of 50 cents per bag. Ask about the punch cards at the Transfer Station Office. SHARPS DISPOSAL - Dodge County Transfer Station accepts sharps/syringes from residents at no charge. * All sharps must be in a leak-proof, puncture-proof sealed container such as a laundry detergent bottle or sharps container. * Bring them to the Dodge County Recycling Center Building and put the container in the large sharps gondola. They are picked up by Mayo Clinic and disposed of in their medical incinerator. PLEASE do not put loose sharps in the drop box recycling bins or in the garbage as this is a health hazard for everyone who handles your waste.
